terrain.dem_source: USGS Astrogeology Mars HRSC+MOLA blended DEM global 200 m v2 (Mars_HRSC_MOLA_BlendDEM_Global_200mp_v2.tif), resampled bilinear to local 200 m grid; sphere R=3396190 m

thermal_inertia.note: Putzig & Mellon 2007 apparent TI (TES bolometer, 20 ppd ~3 km, int16 MSB, units tiu) sampled by HTTP range read of the 30x30 km window (144 px; interpolated pixels masked out with global_ti_msk_*_2007.img). Day file: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-tes-5-timap-v1/mgst_9001/data/global_ti_day_2007.img. Apparent TI, not a true bulk TI; 3 km pixels average over heterogeneous terrain.

albedo.note: TES Lambert albedo, USGS 7410 m (8 ppd) mosaic; mean over 30 px covering the 30x30 km window. Product = Christensen et al. 2001 (PDS GLOBAL_ALBEDO_8PPD).

dci.note: Ruff & Christensen 2002 DCI only available to me as a colorized image (https://www.mars.asu.edu/data/tes_ruffdust, 16 ppd, 3.5 km); no numeric raster found open/no-login, and colour-bar inversion not attempted.

T_mean_K.note: No open global raster of TES annual-mean surface temperature found; not available as a number I saw in a source. Left null (could be taken from Mars Climate Database / REMS / MEDA papers later).

T_diurnal_K.note: Not found as a quotable site value; see T_mean note.

pressure_mbar.note: No quoted site pressure found. Rough barometric ESTIMATE only (NOT a sourced value; assumes P0=6.1 mbar at MOLA datum, scale height ~10.8 km, my DEM mean elev -2436 m): ~7.6 mbar.

rock_abundance.note: No open numeric TES rock-abundance raster found (ASU lists only a colorized Viking IRTM rock map, https://www.mars.asu.edu/data). Not sampled.

thermal_inertia_literature.value: 180 (sand dune) to 605 (bedrock) tiu in situ MEDA traverse; agrees with THEMIS 100 m
